title: BRS symmetry restoration of chiral Abelian Higgs-Kibble theory in dimensional renormalization with a non-anticommuting gamma5
claim: One-loop renormalization of the Abelian Higgs-Kibble model with chiral fermions in a general 't Hooft gauge, BMHV gamma5: computes the anomalous terms that minimal subtraction induces in the ST identities and the asymmetric finite counterterms restoring BRS symmetry, which exist only if the anomaly-cancellation conditions hold.
theory: chiral Abelian Higgs-Kibble model (with scalars, spontaneous breaking), general R_xi gauge

proved: One-loop restorability of BRS iff anomaly cancellation.
